task.title: Review the community PR, the crash issue and the 1.5 eating reports
task.description:
Deferred while VM2 has priority (hub decision variety-matters-priority, 2026-10-17). 1) Review community PR 2 (https://github.com/Evyatar108/Rimworld-VarietyMatters/pull/2) against a reproduction of issue 1 (https://github.com/Evyatar108/Rimworld-VarietyMatters/issues/1): an ownerless ThingDef causes initialization and food-job exceptions on RimWorld 1.6. The contributor supplies a regression harness and reports a successful build; neither has been run. 2) Separately reproduce the 2026-05-17 Workshop reports that pawns stop eating on 1.5, and the 2026-05-03 report of Gourmet Meals with different condiments merging under Vanilla Cooking Expanded. A passing 1.6 test does not close the 1.5 reports. 3) Check whether each fix also applies to VM2, which forked from this code. Dated comments: D:\MyRimworldMods\ModWorkspace\evidence\2026-10-17\steam-recent-comments-dated.json.

Created 2026-10-17 from the mod-portfolio hub (D:\MyRimworldMods\ModWorkspace\MODS.md). Read this repository's CLAUDE.md and the hub's SHARED-PRACTICES.md first, and record results with the hub's templates\MOD-VERIFICATION.md. This task grants no deploy, push, Workshop upload or public reply.
task.notes:
2026-10-17 feedback sweep (all 45 Bug Reports replies, capture D:\MyRimworldMods\ModWorkspace\evidence\2026-10-17\steam-3044059819-2139.json). New reports beyond this task's description, each also filed against VM2: (1) 'Null key while loading dictionary ... label=VarietyRecordV2' on load, 3 reports from 2 players, latest 2026-06-16, after the April update; lead: VarietyRecord.cs:143 saves pawn-keyed trackers by reference (VM2 task vm2-diettracker-null-pawn-key). (2) Pawns repeat one meal and cooks ignore farther ingredients, 4 reports 2024-06 to 2026-08 (vm2-variety-seeking-reports). (3) VCE - Haute forced ingredient variety broken, 2026-02-10, alongside the known Gourmet condiment stacking (vm2-vce-compat-reports). Older items with no follow-up since 2024: malnutrition Feed option missing (Tyfo 2024-01, logs requested, none sent), NullReferenceException on every save (Tagaris 2024-02), 'DietTracker:: Variety reason mismatch' (chainlinc3 2024-05), settings described on the Workshop page missing from the menu (lintence91 2024-06). Status of these is unknown.

2026-10-17 GitHub check (feedback_sweep --github-only): PR 2 now reports CONFLICTING against master, because master gained the 111 April commits pushed today. Commit 1a6e900 (2026-04-18, F-007) already made GetRaceKey null-safe in the same way, (thingDef.modContentPack?.Name ?? "null") + "-" + defName, and VM2 has the same line. Issue 1 was observed on 2026-08-24, four months after that commit, so the Workshop build that player had probably predates the April work. Before reviewing PR 2: confirm which commit the Workshop release was built from (MODS.md release-tracking gap). If the guard is already in what subscribers run, close issue 1 and PR 2 with thanks; the PR's regression harness may still be worth keeping. Any GitHub comment or close is Evyatar's to approve.
